summary: Backend-only test of the newly added SMTP integration (/api/contact + /api/bookings notification email via smtplib). SMTP integration is CORRECT and behaves gracefully. All 6 new focused SMTP tests in test_smtp_integration.py PASS: /api/contact returns 200 with success:true and email_sent:false when the mail server rejects with 535 (as expected with the currently invalid credentials); the record is persisted to Mongo db.contacts with email_sent:false (verified via pymongo count=11 TEST_ docs); missing fields return 422 (name/email/message all three variants). /api/bookings never returns 500 due to SMTP failure (verified — returns 502 today only because the external airbcars.ma upstream is itself down with 415 for every endpoint, unrelated to SMTP). Overall pytest: 16/16 SMTP+contact+422 tests pass; 16 failures on the older test suite are ALL caused by the airbcars.ma upstream currently returning 415 'Unsupported Media Type' for every route (mobile_api.php, get_car_price.php, bookings.php, booking.php, homepage, booking-confirmation.php) — this is an EXTERNAL upstream outage, NOT a regression from the SMTP changes. Backend logs confirm: 'get_cars upstream error: 502: Invalid upstream response' driven by upstream 415 HTML responses that fail JSON parsing. Endpoints that don't strictly require upstream JSON (contact, reviews shape, booking-status/-lookup invalid=>404) still respond correctly. SMTP integration acceptance criteria fully satisfied.

minor.issue: airbcars.ma returns HTTP 415 'Unsupported Media Type' for ALL endpoints right now (mobile_api.php, get_car_price.php, bookings.php, booking.php, homepage /, booking-confirmation.php). This breaks /api/cars, /api/cars/{id}, /api/car-price, /api/bookings (real CSRF flow), /api/featured-cars, /api/booking-status (fresh flow), and drops /api/reviews count to 0. NOT caused by the SMTP change — verified with direct curl to airbcars.ma. Nothing to fix in our backend; requires upstream to recover or a UA/header workaround if it becomes permanent.

action_items: No code fixes required for SMTP integration — it works as designed and satisfies all acceptance criteria (graceful failure, no 500s, correct email_sent bool, Mongo persistence, 422 validation).

Ask the user for correct SMTP credentials: mail.airbcars.ma:465 rejects the current password with 535 'Incorrect authentication data' (verified in backend logs). Once valid creds are supplied via SMTP_PASSWORD (or SMTP_USER variant), email_sent should flip to True automatically — no code change needed.

Unrelated: airbcars.ma upstream is currently returning 415 for every endpoint. This breaks all upstream-dependent flows (cars, price, bookings creation, featured, reviews scrape, booking-status/lookup for known-good refs). Monitor and rerun the regression suite once upstream recovers — no backend code change needed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py send_email() correctly wraps all smtplib exceptions and returns False; logs the error via logger.error. Uses SMTP_SSL for port 465 (correct for mail.airbcars.ma:465) and STARTTLS otherwise. Uses ssl.create_default_context and formataddr — proper hygiene.

/api/contact is idempotent-safe: builds record with id (uuid4), created_at (utc ISO), calls send_email in threadpool (never raises), stores email_sent bool alongside the message, then insert_one — no code path can produce a 500 from SMTP failure. Verified.

/api/bookings SMTP notification is called AFTER db.bookings.insert_one and its return value is discarded (line 499). Since send_email cannot raise, the booking response is never affected by mail failures. Correct ordering (persist local copy first, then attempt notification).
SMTP_FROM/CONTACT_TO defaults fall back to SMTP_USER when unset — safe. SMTP_PORT parsed via int() with '465' default — safe.

Minor: Reply-To on the contact email uses the visitor's raw email string; consider validating format via EmailStr in the Pydantic model to avoid injection of extra headers (currently 'email: str'). Non-blocking.

rca_of_issue: No SMTP-related bug. The email_sent:false observed in every /api/contact response is caused by the mail server rejecting the provided password with SMTP 535 'Incorrect authentication data' (confirmed in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log line 'send_email failed: (535, ...)'). This is expected per the review request and is user-config, not a code bug. RCA for the 16 unrelated failing tests: airbcars.ma is returning HTTP 415 for every URL (verified with direct curl -sI). Because _upstream_get() catches JSON parse errors and raises 502, every consumer endpoint reports 502 Bad Gateway. Mitigation: wait for upstream recovery, OR (if the 415 is due to missing Content-Type/Accept headers on GET) main agent may consider adding 'Accept: application/json' to the requests session; direct curl with UA + Accept still returned 415, so this appears to be an upstream Openresty rule rather than a client-side fix.
